name: Traditional Holiday Spiced Eggnog (Heavy Cream & Nutmeg Warning)
whyItWorks: Packed with heavy cream, whole milk, egg yolks, sugar, and nutmeg. Extremely dense dairy fat and lactose trigger immediate diarrhea, gas, and cramping in sensitive stomachs.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during active IBD. In remission, sip a small 2 oz portion diluted with oat milk or choose dairy-free oat nog.
watchOuts: Very high dairy lactose and fat density trigger rapid gastric dumping
